transcript.text: The extractor fan over my hob has stopped working. Lights come on but the fan just hums when I press the speed buttons, doesn't spin. It's a Bosch chimney hood I think. Is that part of my hob?
Could you tell me a bit more — what kind of appliance is it, what is it doing, and is anything showing on the display or control panel?
It's a Bosch chimney cooker hood above my hob. The speed button lights come on and the fan just hums, no error codes or display that I can see.

I can't diagnose that problem with your hob here yet, so I won't guess at a cause or a part. If there's any burning smell, sparking, smoke or water near the electrics, stop using it and switch it off at the wall. Otherwise an appliance engineer can look at it, or tell me about a different problem with it.
